title: Carvacrol mitigates vancomycin-induced nephrotoxicity via regulation of IkBalpha/p38MAPK and Keap1/Nrf2 signaling pathways: an experimental study with in silico evidence.
authors: Khalaf, M M; Hassan, S M; Sayed, A M; Abo-Youssef, A M
journal: European review for medical and pharmacological sciences
one_liner_zh: 该研究为动物实验探究香芹酚对万古霉素肾毒性的保护机制，仅含少量分子对接，核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Despite its evident renal toxicity, vancomycin is considered an effective glycopeptide antibiotic against life-threatening positive bacterial contagions. The current study aimed to investigate the potential protective effects of carvacrol as well as its underlying mechanism against vancomycin-induced nephrotoxicity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The animals were randomly classified into four groups (8 rats per group). Group I, which served as a control group, received only vehicles. Group II received a single i.p. injection of 50 mg/kg of carvacrol for seven days. Group III received vancomycin (200 mg/kg, i.p.) as a singular daily dose for seven days. Carvacrol was administered to Group IV seven days prior to the daily vancomycin dose. RESULTS: The results revealed that carvacrol minimized vancomycin-induced renal injury as evidenced by lower serum cystatin C levels and kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1), in addition to a decline in renal damage caused by vancomycin as indicated in histopathological assessment. Furthermore, carvacrol significantly attenuated oxidative stress parameters and inflammatory mediators. Moreover, it downregulated Keap1, mitogen-activated protein kinase (p38MAPK), and nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) genes and proteins, along with controlling the NF-kappaB inhibitory protein (IkBalpha) and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) genes and proteins observed through streaming its genes. A molecular docking technique was also used to investigate the potential interactivity between carvacrol and proteins involved in regulating oxidative injury and inflammatory responses. CONCLUSIONS: The current study findings revealed that carvacrol administration before vancomycin could be a promising therapeutic approach for maceration of renal damage stimulated by vancomycin via controlling IkBalpha/MAPK and Keap1/Nrf2 signaling molecules. https://www.europeanreview.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/graphical-abstract-1.jpg.
abstract_zh: 目的：尽管万古霉素具有明显的肾毒性，但它被认为是一种有效的糖肽类抗生素，可对抗危及生命的阳性细菌感染。本研究旨在探讨香芹酚对万古霉素诱导的肾毒性的潜在保护作用及其潜在机制。材料与方法：将动物随机分为四组（每组8只大鼠）。第一组作为对照组，仅接受溶剂。第二组连续七天接受单次腹腔注射50 mg/kg香芹酚。第三组连续七天接受万古霉素（200 mg/kg，腹腔注射）作为每日单次剂量。第四组在每日万古霉素剂量前七天给予香芹酚。结果：结果显示，香芹酚减轻了万古霉素诱导的肾损伤，表现为血清胱抑素C水平和肾损伤分子-1（KIM-1）降低，此外，组织病理学评估显示万古霉素引起的肾损伤有所减轻。进一步地，香芹酚显著减弱了氧化应激参数和炎症介质。此外，它下调了Keap1、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（p38MAPK）和核因子κB（NF-kappaB）的基因和蛋白质，同时通过调控其基因表达控制了NF-kappaB抑制蛋白（IkBalpha）和核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）的基因和蛋白质。还采用分子对接技术探讨了香芹酚与参与调节氧化损伤和炎症反应的蛋白质之间的潜在相互作用。结论：本研究结果表明，在万古霉素给药前给予香芹酚可能是一种有前景的治疗方法，通过调控IkBalpha/MAPK和Keap1/Nrf2信号分子来减轻万古霉素刺激的肾损伤。https://www.europeanreview.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/graphical-abstract-1.jpg。
